scope: Git source files only; no production DB or administrator-created drafts
normalization: NFKC, lowercase, strip non-ASCII-alphanumeric; normalized full-item substring in all source.json and instrument.ts blobs
limits: Not a semantic equivalence or licensed item-lineage proof.
Chinese translations and adapted source-family overlap require administrator review; reference-list citation does not establish item equivalence.
Production DB, administrator drafts and branches with no PR not independently queried.
If a matching existing source/version is later found, reference it rather than create another tool.
